body_markdown:
**Truist to serve as presenting partner of SMU Women’s Athletics as part of wide-ranging partnership**


**DALLAS (SMU)** – Mustang Partners and SMU Athletics announced a new partnership with Truist Financial Corporation, highlighted by Truist becoming the presenting partner of SMU Women’s Athletics.


The multi-year partnership will provide Truist with a significant presence across SMU Athletics while creating new opportunities to showcase and celebrate SMU women’s sports, student-athletes and the history of women’s athletics at SMU.


“We are excited to welcome Truist as a partner of SMU Athletics and to work together to elevate and celebrate our women’s sports programs,” said **Dawn Rogers, Deputy AD of Internal Affairs. "** This partnership goes beyond traditional branding. Truist is investing in opportunities to tell the stories of women’s sports at SMU and champion our student-athletes on and off the field.”


Through this partnership, Truist will be integrated into digital and social content across SMU’s women’s sports programs, including gameday and final score content throughout the year.


The partnership will also include a six-part social media series celebrating the history of SMU Women’s Athletics, providing a platform to highlight the student-athletes, teams and moments that have helped shape SMU Athletics.


“North Texas is an important growth market for Truist, and we're committed to investing in the people, institutions and opportunities that help our communities thrive,” said **DeVon Lang, Truist North Texas Regional President** . “Our partnership with SMU reflects that commitment while creating new opportunities to celebrate the accomplishments of women student-athletes, support the next generation of leaders and strengthen our connection to the North Texas community. This collaboration aligns with Truist's purpose to inspire and build better lives and communities, and we're proud to support a program with such a meaningful impact.”


Truist will also have a prominent presence at competitions held at Moody Coliseum with branding on team bench chairbacks for volleyball, women’s basketball and men’s basketball.


The partnership extends across the Hilltop with permanent signage at the Styslinger/Altec Tennis Complex supporting SMU men’s and women’s tennis.


Truist will also engage Mustang fans throughout the football season through in-stadium LED signage and a Boulevard activation space on SMU football gamedays. The partnership includes hospitality opportunities at select games at Gerald J. Ford Stadium and a future leadership event featuring SMU Head Football Coach Rhett Lashlee.


Through its combination of storytelling, gameday activations, brand visibility and fan engagement, the partnership will provide Truist with a year-round presence across SMU Athletics while creating meaningful opportunities to support and celebrate SMU student-athletes.


###


**About SMU Athletics**


It's a new era of Athletics at SMU. In the classroom and on the field, SMU is driving excellence and growth to be among the best athletics programs in the country. We are bringing the highest level of collegiate competition to Dallas,[which was recently named the No. 1 city for sports business by the Sports Business Journal](https://www.sportsbusinessjournal.com/Journal/Issues/2023/03/20/In-Depth/best-sports-business-cities.aspx) , and building on our recent success, with all 17 programs reaching the postseason and 16 programs winning conference championships since 2013. SMU is the only NCAA FBS program in Dallas, and has claimed 10 overall national championships, over 200 team conference championships, over 100 individual national championships, more than 150 NCAA top-10 finishes, nearly 2,000 All-American honors and over 150 Olympic appearances. Since 2013, SMU has invested over $250 million to develop and enhance championship-caliber facilities. SMU is a member of the Atlantic Coast Conference.


**About Truist**


Truist Financial Corporation (NYSE: TFC) is a purpose-driven financial services company committed to inspiring and building better lives and communities. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Truist has leading market share in many of the high-growth markets in the U.S. and offers a wide range of products and services through wholesale and consumer businesses, including consumer and small business banking, commercial and corporate banking, investment banking and capital markets, wealth management, payments, and specialized lending businesses. Truist is a top-10 commercial bank with total assets of $556 billion as of June 30, 2026. Truist Bank, Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender. Learn more at[Truist.com](https://www.truist.com/) .
